note: THE SEAM for the Nano Banana -> Meshy -> game pipeline. A kind listed in `models` is loaded, re-materialed as the alive-skin and voxelised into the damage lattice at boot; a kind that is absent is never requested, so this file is also what stops the loader 404ing for art that is not in the tree. `assets/README.md` is the drop-in guide.
tuning: Each kind may be a bare filename or {file, size, tint}. size is the largest dimension in world units; tint MULTIPLIES the baked albedo, so "#c8c0b4" pulls a Meshy skin toward bone without flattening its texture.
off: Nothing is registered by DEFAULT, deliberately. A registered kind replaces that enemy's hand-authored sculpt AND its smoothed alive-hull (the v4.31 and v4.32 work) wholesale, which is an art decision rather than a fix - the gate's hull section stops passing the moment skull is registered, which is the gate saying exactly that. Turn one on by naming it here, then LOOK at a render.
voxel: as: "voxel" is the retro route (v38): the export is scaled to its slot's height, rasterized at `pitch` (default a third of the slot pitch), snapped to the house palette (`palette`: bone | keep), given HDR eyes at `eyes` (normalized x,y,z; z=1 is the FRONT) within `eyeR` cells, and the bottom `jaw` fraction becomes the hinged jaw. Chips, islands, gibs and the bone-yard work unchanged. `tilt` (radians about x) and `yaw` (about y) turn an export that did not arrive facing +z upright; `lift` scales a dark bake's luminance before the bone curve.
